phases.aim: Build peak aerobic volume (65–73 km/wk), 20–22 km long runs with MP/HM finishes, repeatable 1k–5k threshold/CV reps, and first back-to-back weekend durability blocks. 10K / stacked checkpoint 30 Jan.

phases.aim: Multi-race Saturday turnaround simulations (1k/3k/5k stacks with carb fueling & rapid lactate clearance) + tired-leg Sunday HM-pace runs. current_call.headline: 15.3 km long run banked early Saturday — trim Sunday to 7–9 km easy + sauna
current_call.summary: Saturday's planned easy parkrun became a disciplined 15.29 km aerobic long run (5:24.4/km watch → 5:01.6/km EAP v2.0, avg HR 132, 97% Z1–Z2), bringing Week 6 to 49.0 km through Saturday. Swapping the weekend — trimming Sunday from 15 km to a relaxed 7–9 km shakeout + sauna — lands Week 6 cleanly on target at 56–58 km and leaves fresh legs for Tuesday's 10 × 1 km Norwegian threshold session in Week 7.

reports.title: 15.29 km aerobic group run + parkrun cruise at 132 bpm
reports.summary: Banked Sunday's long run a day early with a 5 km jog to Armidale parkrun, 5 km strictly easy inside parkrun, and 5.3 km home (15.29 km total, +117/−119 m, 1:22:36 moving). Total restraint from start to finish: 5:24.4/km watch → 5:01.6/km EAP v2.0 acclimatised into a 19.5 km/h NW breeze, spending 97% of the run in Z1–Z2 (out 5 km avg HR 128, parkrun 5 km avg HR 135, return 5.3 km avg HR 133 — zero cardiac drift).
reports.adaptation: Sunday 22 Nov adjusted from 15 km to 7–9 km easy + sauna so Week 6 finishes right at 56–58 km (plan: 56 km) ahead of Week 7's 10 × 1 km @ T.

reports.title: Block realigned for the Armidale Running Festival Golden Ticket
reports.summary: Instead of peaking for a standalone 5 km in March, the entire 22-week block now peaks 100% for the Armidale Running Festival Golden Ticket (13–14 March 2027): every race across the weekend combined for cumulative time — three 1 km dashes, 3 km, 5 km, and 10 km on Saturday afternoon (21 km stacked), followed 14 hours later by Sunday morning's Half Marathon (21.1 km). Because the 10 km and Half Marathon represent ~75% of total elapsed time, Weeks 10–22 shift toward bigger threshold cruise sets (up to 2 × 5 km), 20–22 km long runs with marathon/HM finishes, back-to-back weekend simulations, heat-acclimation saunas for March afternoon warmth, and rehearsing overnight glycogen reload.
reports.adaptation: Weekend adjustment (20–22 Nov): Saturday parkrun downgraded from tempo + 200s to easy aerobic after stacking 3 hard sessions Tue–Thu (rolling 7-day volume 54.7 km), preserving Sunday's 14–15 km long run.

reports.title: 5 × 1.6 km Threshold Miles: 3:51.6/km EAP at 160 bpm
reports.summary: Biggest aerobic jump of the block so far. Ten days after TT1 anchored threshold pace at 4:01/km EAP (4:09–4:10/km Armidale watch), 8.0 km of threshold miles with 60 s jog recoveries averaged 4:02.9/km watch — 3:51.6/km EAP v2.0 acclimatised — while keeping heart rate strictly inside Z3 (160 bpm average, 169 max). Reps 1–2 opened slightly hot (3:47–3:48/km EAP), settling smoothly into 3:52–3:56/km EAP across Reps 3–5.

reports.title: Week 5 closed at 47.1 km — plus biomechanics of the 'Milk Kilometer'
reports.summary: Wrapped Week 5 cleanly at 47.05 km against 48 km planned with a relaxed 8.44 km Sunday morning run (5:17.3/km watch → 4:48.9/km EAP v2.0, avg HR 131, 99.4% Z1–Z2). Fun data-nerd highlight: an 8:20 shop stop at 7.26 km turned the final 1.18 km (+27 m climb) home into a ~1.5 kg hand-carried milk run (~0.75 kg per hand). Wrist running dynamics caught it immediately — cadence rose +3.5 spm (to 173 spm at the finish), step length shortened −7.4 cm, and vertical oscillation flattened by −4.6 mm to stop the milk sloshing. Unloaded EAP on that final climb was 4:27.4/km (~4:14–4:18/km effort-equivalent accounting for distal hand load and restricted arm swing).

reports.title: Textbook controlled Parkrun tempo inside 12.58 km total
reports.summary: Ran 3.84 km warm-up to Armidale parkrun, executed a disciplined 4.98 km threshold tempo in 21:17.5 (4:16.3/km watch → 3:54.1/km EAP v2.0 acclimatised, 162 bpm avg HR, 444 W), and jogged 3.75 km back. Every single kilometre of the 5 km negative-split in EAP effort (3:57.8 → 3:57.0 → 3:54.0 → 3:51.6 → 3:50.1/km) without ever racing the clock.

reports.title: 3 × 10 min @ Threshold: 7.0 km work at 4:09/km EAP
reports.summary: First Week 5 quality session following TT1: 10.93 km total with 30 minutes (7.00 km) of threshold cruising at 4:17.3/km watch → 4:09.1/km EAP v2.0, holding 166 bpm avg HR and 438 W before an afternoon gym session.

reports.title: TT1 (5 km Checkpoint): 19:32.6 raw → 18:47.2 EAP (VDOT 53.6)
reports.summary: First benchmark time trial of the block at Armidale parkrun (~990 m altitude, hilly out-and-back). Clocked 19:32.6 raw (3:54.4/km) at 171 bpm average HR (183 max) and 478 W. Environment Adjusted Pace put the effort at 18:47.2 acclimatised (3:45.4/km) and 18:29.9 sea-level equivalent (3:42.0/km), lifting block VDOT from the 51.3 starting estimate to 53.6.

days.title: GOLDEN TICKET DAY 1 (21 km)
days.detail: Armidale Running Festival Sat 13 Mar: 1k + 1k + 1k (~12:00–1:30 pm), 3k (~2:15 pm), 5k (~3:00 pm), 10k (~4:00 pm). STRATEGY: Run the three 1ks & 3k controlled (~93–95%, ZERO redline), 5k @ strong {CV}/10K, 10k @ disciplined {T}/HM+. Between races: 3–5 min easy flush jog, legs up in shade, ice/cold towel on neck, 30–40 g carbs + sodium per gap. AT 4:40 PM FINISH: immediate 80–90 g/h carb + 35 g protein + heavy fluid/sodium reload for 4 h!

days.title: GOLDEN TICKET DAY 2: HALF MARATHON
days.detail: Sun 14 Mar (~7:00 am): 21.1 km Half Marathon (~51% of total Golden Ticket time!). Wake 2.5 h early, 1.5–2 g/kg low-fibre carb breakfast, caffeine ~200–250 mg 60 min pre, 10 min very easy warm-up. Start conservative for km 1–5 (let yesterday's legs open up), lock into goal HM pace km 6–15 (fuel 60–80 g/h carbs), and hunt down everyone who blew up Saturday over the last 6 km!
